newsitem.title: UK: Halifax B/Soc to detail float on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Halifax B/Soc to detail float on Friday.

text.p: The Halifax Building Society, the UK's largest mortgage lender, will give details of its planned stock exchange flotation and conversion to a bank on Friday, a spokeswoman for the mutual society told Reuters on Wednesday.

"It (the transfer document) is expected to go out on Friday," she said, adding it would give full details of the building society's transfer plans and the likely share distribution to its members if they vote for the conversion.
Analysts have recently increased their estimates for the likely size of the Halifax float to around 11.0 billion stg from previous predictions of around 10.0 billion stg.

This reflects the Halifax's own performance and the fact that the most comparable stock, Abbey National Plc, the first and only building society to become a bank to date, has been outperforming the market.

Earlier this week the Woolwich Building Society, which plans to float in July, said its financial advisers had made an historic valuation putting its market capitalisation at between 2.96 and 3.38 billion stg. The flotation will bring an average windfall of over 1,200 stg to its members.
